title: feat(console): business-first Approvals Inbox revamp
body:
## Summary

Companion to objectstack-ai/framework#1728. Rebuilds the Approvals Inbox from a developer debug view into a business workbench. Full e2e review + redesign rationale: tested against the showcase app (approve / reject / recall / multi-step chain / bulk / keyboard / mobile all verified in-browser).

**P0 fixes**
- Role-addressed approvals never reached "My Pending": `buildApproverIdentities` only read a `roles` array, but better-auth sessions carry a single `role` string (possibly comma-separated). Both shapes resolve now.
- Pending resolves every identity in ONE comma-separated `approverId` request (the server already supported it).
- The tab badge is a dedicated my-pending count — it previously counted the *active tab's* rows, so it showed the global pending count while browsing "All".
- Disabled Approve/Reject now always explain why (the explanation used to vanish whenever Recall was available); bulk approve gets a confirmation dialog; API errors toast as business language instead of `HTTP_404: Not found`.

**P1 — information architecture**
- Rows lead with flow display label + record-title link + requester name (server-enriched), semantic status colors, relative times with aging tints.
- Drawer: business summary card (record link, requester, formatted key payload fields), action timeline, raw JSON collapsed by default, actor override admin-only.
- Search covers record titles / requester names / process labels ("Compliance Audit" went 0 → 3 hits); status filter added on non-pending tabs.
- Full i18n: `approvalsInbox.*` keys in all ten locales (locale-parity test green).

**P2 — efficiency**
- Hover quick approve/reject per row (reject confirms), `j/k/Enter/x/a/r` keyboard flow with a hint line, card layout on mobile (the table used to truncate to 2 columns at 375px).

## Test plan

- `@object-ui/i18n`: 100/100 (incl. locale-parity) ✅
- console suite: 3598 passed / 24 skipped ✅
- `tsc --noEmit` clean on console + i18n ✅
- In-browser e2e against showcase (3700/5790): my-pending badge math, drawer approve with comment, inline reject confirm, recall confirm → `recalled` + timeline entry, bulk approve confirm → 2 approved, keyboard a/r, mobile cards, zero console errors ✅
